C9000281.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 281 (QAOA attains the SK optimum in the thermodynamic-first limit.; papers: QAOA attains the SK ground-state energy in the thermodynamic-first limit; Full support of the zero-temperature Sherrington-Kirkpatrick order parameter; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/281.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Q_MAIN.statement: QAOA thm:main: lim_{p->infinity} Q_p=P_* with one deterministic finite word chosen before the thermodynamic limit.

Q_TRANSFER.statement: prop:tree-transfer and prop:energy identify fixed-word SK energy with Re<v,Lv>, not merely a Gaussian marginal.

Q_CLASSICAL.statement: prop:classical-near-optimum supplies bounded exclusion formulas of energy approaching P_*.

Q_CLASSICAL_POSITIVE.statement: The alternative prop:classical-near-optimum-positive-temperature uses positive-temperature support, finite-step, continuum and symmetric-power limits instead of SK_FULL.

Q_SYNTHESIS.statement: thm:classical-synthesis implements bounded smooth exclusion formulas with seeded cost-mixer circuits and energy error <=2 eta+2 sqrt(p_H).

Q_SEED.statement: thm:seed-simulation removes the same reused longitudinal Gaussian seed at every requested gate while preserving root-shift energy.

Q_PACKET.statement: lem:seed-packet-estimates and lem:seed-high-directions: number-smooth packet bounds, separation and weak escape of the two initialized directions.

Q_SELECTIVE.statement: lem:seed-selective-accuracy gives ordinary o(r), normalized-special o(1), uniformly for moving number-smooth input families, using actual changing insertion directions.

Q_ENSEMBLE.statement: lem:seed-ensemble-control gives exact finite simultaneous X rotations with both clocks zero for finitely many nonzero projection pairs.

Q_ECHO.statement: lem:seed-one-echo gives (t/r)(v'_r-v_r)=-2tw_r+o(1) and transports the same w_r through compensated noncommuting mixers and repeated echoes.

Q_GRAM.statement: lem:seed-gram-induction identifies the endogenous/external joint Grams and, by a separate one-particle calculation, the root-shift energy.

Q_VISIBILITY.statement: Formal visibility functions are nonzero analytic functions; one generic perturbation and successive probe selection supply all standard and huge-stage projection conditions.

SK_FULL.statement: Companion thm:full-support: every zero-temperature SK minimizer has full relative Stieltjes support [0,1), strict increase and q(t)=t, q'(t)=1.

SK_SCALAR.statement: Companion Corollary 7.1 and Proposition 7.2 supply the scalar value and shifted finite Gaussian coefficient identity used in QAOA section 3.

SK_CURVATURE.statement: prop:gap-curvature: on an open constant interval gamma=c>0, q''' >= E[v^4]/(1000c^2)>0; for c=0, q' strictly increases.

SK_SIGNS.statement: tail:class, shape:backward, shape:forward and shape:ibp provide the backward/forward signs and integrated identities under their hypotheses.

SK_CERTIFICATE.statement: cert:identity-lemma and cert:coercivity assert the exact polynomial identity and its integrated lower bound 1661507/1521000000 times E[v^4].

SK_REGULARITY.statement: lem:regularity, lem:diffusion and lem:constant-transfer give compact-strip regularity, the gradient martingale and constant-interval differentiation.

SK_CONTACT.statement: lem:contact gives G>=0, G=0 on the support and q(s)=s, q'(s)<=1 at interior support points.

SK_ENDPOINT.statement: lem:no-terminal-plateau excludes a terminal support plateau, using ACZ2017 Remark 7.

SR_WEIGHTED.statement: For fixed formally visible seed words and finite exact zero-clock control data, the actual compiler has ordinary H<-Dom(1+N) operator defect <=Cr^2, normalized-special defect <=Cr, the same initial w_r transported to Cr through arbitrary finite noncommuting mixers and echoes, residual seed error <=Cr and root-shift energy error <=Cr. Moving tails of graph norm O(r^-a), a<1, retain ordinary o(r).

SR_ENERGY_TEST.statement: After finite symmetric local seed processing U, one cost gamma and mixer eta have energy gamma exp(-2 gamma^2) sin(4 eta) E<X>_U. Two reused seed pulses of angles 1/2 separated by mixer pi/4, read at gamma=1/2, eta=pi/8, exceed their fresh-seed counterpart by exp(-1/2)(1-exp(-1))^2/4>0.

SR_CORE.statement: For arbitrary real normed spaces, isometric prefixes and anticommuting target flips, four forward-action errors bound insertion changes without orthogonality; finite transport errors add and quadratic defects rescale linearly. The reused/fresh energy gap scalar is strictly positive.
